payload.title: Architecture & Build Plan
payload.description:
This is a note that describes a plan to build an app. Build the app it describes.

— Note: Pixel Landscape —

Single-file HTML/JS app. Canvas 2D at 256x128 base resolution upscaled with image-rendering:pixelated. 5 parallax layers: sky, mountains, trees/hills, ocean/beach, foreground. Perlin noise terrain generation. 6-minute day/night cycle with palette interpolation. Weather (clear, fog, drizzle, mist). Autonomous pixel animals (birds, crabs, rabbits, deer, fireflies) with simple AI. Auto-panning camera. Tap interaction with ripple effects. No audio. Must run at 60fps. Minimal, elegant, peaceful. Pure Canvas 2D, no frameworks. Base resolution switches between 256x128 (landscape) and 128x256 (portrait) based on device orientation.

Your role in the swarm: Architecture & Build Plan. Build your slice — do not re-plan or produce alternative variations.
